short_description: Consumer-facing physical trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal related to body weight tendency within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing physical trait with workable raw-array support and a clearer interpretation boundary between inherited body-weight tendency and current measured weight for the no-imputation workflow.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with body weight tendency, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: Body weight tendency is presented here as a cautious panel-relative body-size signal, not as a direct readout of your current measured weight. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as a deterministic real-world result, a direct body-weight measurement, or health advice.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.

Real-world body weight depends strongly on sex, age, nutrition, training, illness, medication use, fluid balance, and many other non-genetic factors, so this should not be treated as a precise estimate of current weight.
Body weight alone is a limited body-size measure and does not distinguish fat mass, lean mass, frame size, or metabolic health.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
